# Kit Finder

> Kit Finder (wearekitfinder.com) is a free search engine for vintage, retro and classic football shirts. It brings together listings from hundreds of independent specialist shops in one place, so collectors can find a shirt by team, season, kit version (home, away, third, goalkeeper) and size, compare prices and go straight to the shop that sells it. Kit Finder does not sell shirts itself.

Useful facts:
- Prices shown are the asking prices of each shop's listing, converted to the visitor's currency; condition and size change the price.
- Listings come from independent shops; Kit Finder does not authenticate shirts.
- Available in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Dutch, Polish and Portuguese.

## Main pages
- [Search](https://wearekitfinder.com/): search every listed shop at once by team, season, version and size
- [Why Kit Finder](https://wearekitfinder.com/why): what Kit Finder is and how it works
- [Advanced search](https://wearekitfinder.com/shirt-checker): see how many shirts are listed for any team, size and season, and their average price
- [Long sleeve kits](https://wearekitfinder.com/long-sleeve-kits): long-sleeve vintage football shirts

## Browse by team
- [Leagues](https://wearekitfinder.com/leagues): Premier League, La Liga, Serie A and Bundesliga shirt pages
- [Clubs](https://wearekitfinder.com/clubs): major clubs, with price ranges, seasons and shops for each
- [National teams](https://wearekitfinder.com/national): national team shirts
- [All teams A-Z](https://wearekitfinder.com/teams): every team with its own page

## La Grada (blog)
- [La Grada](https://wearekitfinder.com/blog): stories and history behind football shirts
- [The Golden Era of Goalkeeper Kits](https://wearekitfinder.com/blog/golden-era-goalkeeper-kits): 90s goalkeeper shirts that went wild
- [When Fashion Met Football](https://wearekitfinder.com/blog/when-fashion-met-football): non-sportswear brands that made iconic kits
